projects.title: Digital Experience
projects.intro: A modern interactive website demonstrating sophisticated frontend development.
projects.description: An immersive product narrative built around motion, typography, and spatial storytelling. The experience balances cinematic visuals with precise information architecture so visitors can explore without losing orientation.
objectives: Establish a memorable first impression within three seconds
Keep performance high while preserving visual richness
designDecisions: Editorial layouts replace dense card grids
Motion is reserved for hierarchy and continuity
Dark surfaces emphasize luminous accent geometry
implementation: Modular section system with progressive enhancement
GPU-conscious animation budgets and lazy media loading
Accessible keyboard paths for all primary interactions
projects.caseStudy: This demonstration project explores how cinematic motion and restrained UI chrome can coexist. The focus is clarity under spectacle — every animation has a job.

projects.title: Creative Technology
projects.intro: An experimental visual experience featuring interactive geometry and animation.
projects.description: A playground of generative forms, shader-inspired lighting, and reactive geometry. Built to prove that experimental aesthetics can still communicate a coherent brand world.
objectives: Make interaction feel physical and responsive
Showcase creative coding without sacrificing usability
designDecisions: Violet emissive accents as the sole chromatic signal
Controls remain secondary to the visual field
implementation: Canvas and WebGL experiments loaded on demand
Shared design tokens across experiment shells
Fallback states when WebGL is unavailable
projects.caseStudy: Creative Technology treats the browser as a laboratory. Visitors can poke, drag, and reset systems that demonstrate ORBIT’s experimental language.

projects.title: Digital Platform
projects.intro: A modern interface demonstrating responsive design, information architecture, and user experience.
projects.description: A structured product surface focused on clarity, hierarchy, and adaptive layouts. It shows how ORBIT translates immersive thinking into practical interface systems.
objectives: Communicate complex information with calm hierarchy
Remain fully usable across phone, tablet, and desktop
Connect frontend craft with a typed Python API
designDecisions: Asymmetric editorial blocks instead of rigid card walls
Consistent violet focus states for accessibility
implementation: FastAPI endpoints serving centralized JSON content
projects.caseStudy: Digital Platform demonstrates that ORBIT is not only visual theater — it is also a maintainable content and API architecture ready for iteration.
